# Menu

A menu input component.

<template v-if="language === 'js'">

## menu {#menu-method}

`menu(options)`

Creates a [Menu](#menu-class) client, connects it to the active coordinator and returns its containing HTML element. The vgplot wrapper uses an explicitly supplied API context coordinator when present; the mosaic-inputs helper uses the default coordinator.

</template>

<template v-else-if="language === 'python'">

## menu

`vg.menu(label: Any = None, bind: Any = None, options: Any = None, value: Any = None, source: Any = None, column: Any = None, filter_by: Any = None, **opts: Any)`

Create a menu view from literal options or a backing table.

Python input helpers return serializable View objects, rather than DOM widgets or MosaicClient instances. The bind argument serializes as as, source serializes as from, and other keyword names use camel case. Options whose value is None are omitted before aliases are applied; for example menu(bind=selection, as_=None) retains the bind argument. False, zero and empty strings remain present. Unknown keyword options are retained for custom clients.

Python option(label) uses the label as its value; option(label, None) keeps an explicit null value. In a mixed options list containing a dictionary, Python converts every non-dictionary entry into a label/value dictionary. An all-scalar list remains scalar. The JavaScript menu client treats each scalar option as a value and each object as an option record.

</template>

## Declarative options

The JSON/YAML object uses `input: "menu"`. Only this discriminator is required. Native JavaScript uses the options object without the discriminator.

| Option | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `as` | No | The output selection. A selection clause is added for the currently selected menu option. |
| `field` | No | The database column name to use within generated selection clause predicates. Defaults to the `column` property. |
| `from` | No | The name of a database table to use as a data source for this widget. Used in conjunction with the `column` property. |
| `column` | No | The name of a database column from which to pull menu options. The unique column values are used as menu options. Used in conjunction with the `from` property. |
| `listMatch` | No | Required if the database column is an list, this property determines how to match the selected menu option against the list values. |
| `filterBy` | No | A selection to filter the database table indicated by the `from` property. |
| `label` | No | A text label for this input. |
| `options` | No | An array of menu options, as literal values or option objects. Option objects have a `value` property and an optional `label` property. If no label is provided, the string-coerced value is used. |
| `value` | No | The initial selected menu value, including for a menu without a Param or Selection binding. |

## Menu {#menu-class}

`new Menu(options)`

Native JavaScript class extending [MosaicClient](../core/client). Its `element` property contains the input DOM. The constructor accepts the same native options as the helper. Python does not export this JavaScript runtime class.

The Menu, Search and Slider runtime clients retain database query activation, DOM event handling and Param/Selection updates. Native JavaScript options can include element and, for Menu, format; these host values are outside the JSON/YAML input schema.



Native JavaScript clients accept an existing container DOM element; declarative input definitions do not serialize DOM nodes.

Native JavaScript menus accept a formatting callback; declarative menu definitions do not serialize callbacks.

## Executable starters

The shared starters create a three-row SQL table, bind a named Param or Selection, and return live inputs. The filtered slider starter links a category menu to the slider range. JSON/YAML declare the view, JavaScript returns DOM, and Python serializes a Spec.

| Variant | Downloads |
| --- | --- |
| `menu-table` | [JSON](/templates/inputs/basic/menu-table.json), [YAML](/templates/inputs/basic/menu-table.yaml), [JavaScript](/templates/inputs/basic/menu-table.js), <a :href="withBase('/templates/inputs/basic/menu-table.py')" download>Python</a> |

[Python authoring extensions](./authoring) document input, option, select and checkbox. The [native JavaScript menu](/templates/inputs/basic/native-menu.js) demonstrates DOM and formatting adapters.
